objects.description: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has used names like `adobeupdate.dat` and `PotPlayerDB.dat` to disguise [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013), and a file named `OneDrive.exe` to load a [Cobalt Strike](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154) payload.(Citation: Recorded Future REDDELTA July 2020) [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has also masqueraded legitimate browser plugin updates to include AdobePlugins.exe.(Citation: Google Threat Intelligence Group MUSTANG PANDA PLUGX August 2025)
